reviewed_by: Codex focused review of Nebula settings assistant worktree
reason: The assistant follow-up adds a bounded Project Policy execution-mode command. It opens the shared Settings lens, asks for explicit Host access confirmation, preserves unrelated policy fields with a revision check, reads the saved mode from Core, and shows the result before closing. The catalog and provider/harness prompt now locate the mode. Select five Core settings tests, eleven focused UI tests, the assistant interaction in eight browser profiles, and the production LAN real-Core mode-change journey in desktop Chromium and 320 px WebKit.
exclusions: No native code changed. Unrelated Python, frontend, and Playwright journeys and full suites are excluded. The eight-profile UI journey uses mocked Core for interaction and viewport behavior; the two real-Core browser runs prove durable policy and production LAN behavior. Physical-device testing is unavailable and not claimed.
